what_happened: Scene: grey kettle with an arched handle on the counter right of the gas hob (pot on the hob); same layout as s2/s3. Stage 0: the gripper came down 96-124 with the handle at roughly 45 deg across the wrist image. Contact 109-125, hold 115-126 with 3 mm lift. At 128-132 the fingers are closed in front of the handle, and at 140-152 the gripper rose without the kettle. From ~176 to 1000 it hovered 15-40 cm above the kettle, which stays in the wrist view the whole time (sometimes with the hob), and it never came down to touch it again (no contact after 125); it only drifted lower at ~900-1000. No knob was touched; the kettle moved 0.4 cm.
causal_chain: single grasp attempt 109-126 slid off the diagonal handle (lift 3 mm) -> hovered above the kettle 176-1000 (~820 steps) without re-grasping -> stage 0 never complete
self_recovery: none effective: only a slow descent near the end (900-1000).
official_criterion_notes: Official labeler output is meaningless (it starts at TurnOnStove).
uncertain_about: A ~45 deg handle also appears at first touch in successes s25/s27, so orientation alone does not explain the miss. The hovering behaviour itself is clear.
